# Command-line reference

All commands are run as `cba <command> ...`. Every command also accepts `-h` / `--help`. `cba --version` prints the installed version.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`init`](#cba-init) | create a starter codebook, items file and run config |
| [`validate`](#cba-validate) | check codebook files |
| [`render`](#cba-render) | print the prompt a codebook produces |
| [`templates`](#cba-templates) | list built-in prompt templates |
| [`convert`](#cba-convert) | spreadsheet/CSV (one row per category) -> codebook YAML |
| [`ablate`](#cba-ablate) | base codebook + extra fields -> one variant per field and/or all fields |
| [`check-invariance`](#cba-check-invariance) | check prompts differ only in the codebook block (first = reference) |
| [`run`](#cba-run) | annotate a dataset |
| [`aggregate`](#cba-aggregate) | one row per annotation -> one item per text with per-annotator labels |
| [`overlap`](#cba-overlap) | flag items containing any word from a codebook field |
| [`strip-text`](#cba-strip-text) | remove text, raw_response and evidence quotes from run files (for sharing) |
| [`evaluate`](#cba-evaluate) | Evaluation workbook: F1/Jaccard/Hamming, Krippendorff alpha, slices, agreement |
| [`bootstrap`](#cba-bootstrap) | Paired bootstrap CIs and p-values vs a baseline run (incl. out-of-range labels) |
| [`disagreements`](#cba-disagreements) | Item-level audit CSV of disagreements between runs and with annotators |
| [`annotator-disagreements`](#cba-annotator-disagreements) | Per item x category annotator disagreement matrix CSV |

## cba init

Create a starter codebook, items file and run config in a folder.

    cba init [options] [folder]

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `folder` | target folder (default: current folder) |

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--force` |  | off | overwrite existing files |

## cba validate

Check codebook files and list errors and warnings.

    cba validate [options] codebooks ...

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `codebooks ...` | codebook YAML file(s) |

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--template` | `TEMPLATE` | `default_v1` | template you plan to use (only affects a hint, default: default_v1) |

## cba render

Print the exact system prompt a codebook produces.

    cba render [options] codebook

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `codebook` | codebook YAML file |

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--template` | `TEMPLATE` | `default_v1` | prompt template name or file (default: default_v1) |
| `--text` | `TEXT` |  | also print the user prompt for this text |
| `--few-shot` |  | off | include the codebook's examples |
| `--evidence` |  | off | ask for evidence quotes |

## cba templates

List the built-in prompt templates and their wording.

    cba templates

## cba convert

Turn a table with one row per category into a codebook YAML. Every other column becomes a field, rendered in column order.

    cba convert --output OUTPUT [options] input

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `input` | table file (.xlsx, .csv, .tsv, .jsonl or .json) |

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` | `OUTPUT` |  | codebook YAML to write (required) |
| `--sheet` | `SHEET` |  | sheet name for .xlsx input (default: first sheet) |
| `--category-column` | `CATEGORY_COLUMN` |  | column holding the category names (default: first column) |
| `--columns` | `COLUMNS` |  | comma-separated columns to use, in render order (default: all) |
| `--label` | `FIELD=LABEL` |  | display label for a field Repeatable. |
| `--list-column` | `LIST_COLUMN` |  | column holding a list (split on --list-sep) Repeatable. |
| `--list-sep` | `LIST_SEP` | `,` | separator for list columns (default: ,) |
| `--categories` | `CATEGORIES` |  | comma-separated expected category names (case-insensitive match) |
| `--allow-empty` |  | off | allow empty cells (default: error) |
| `--add-name` |  | off | add a rendered 'name' field = category key |
| `--id` | `ID` |  | codebook id to write into the file |
| `--version` | `VERSION` |  | codebook version to write into the file |
| `--author` | `AUTHOR` |  | author recorded under provenance |

## cba ablate

Build codebook variants: the base codebook plus one added field each, and the base plus all added fields. Base fields are copied verbatim.

    cba ablate --base BASE --extension EXTENSION --fields FIELDS --out-dir OUT_DIR [options]

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--base` | `BASE` |  | base codebook YAML (fields copied verbatim) (required) |
| `--extension` | `EXTENSION` |  | table with one row per category holding the added fields (required) |
| `--fields` | `FIELDS` |  | comma-separated extension columns to add, in order (required) |
| `--out-dir` | `OUT_DIR` |  | folder for the variant YAML files (required) |
| `--prefix` | `PREFIX` | `variant` | file name prefix of the variants (default: variant) |
| `--name` | `FIELD=SHORT` |  | short name for a field's variant Repeatable. |
| `--full-name` | `FULL_NAME` | `full` | name of the all-fields variant (default: full) |
| `--label` | `FIELD=LABEL` |  | display label for an added field Repeatable. |
| `--sheet` | `SHEET` |  | sheet name for .xlsx extension tables |
| `--category-column` | `CATEGORY_COLUMN` |  | extension column holding the category names (default: first column) |
| `--no-single` |  | off | only build the all-fields variant |
| `--no-full` |  | off | only build single-field variants |
| `--author` | `AUTHOR` |  | author recorded under provenance |

## cba check-invariance

Check that the prompts of several codebooks differ only in the category block. The first codebook is the reference the others are compared with.

    cba check-invariance [options] codebooks ...

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `codebooks ...` | two or more codebook YAML files |

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--template` | `TEMPLATE` | `default_v1` | prompt template (default: default_v1) |
| `--few-shot` |  | off | render with the codebooks' examples |
| `--evidence` |  | off | render with evidence quotes requested |

## cba run

Annotate a dataset. Settings come from --config file(s) (JSON/YAML, later files override earlier) and options below (override files).

    cba run [options]

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-c`, `--config` | `CONFIG` |  | run config file (repeatable) |
| `--dry-run` |  | off | validate, sample and render without calling the model |
| `--show-prompt` |  | off | with --dry-run: print the system prompt |
| `--print-config` |  | off | print the merged configuration and exit |

**Run settings (override config files)**

Each option sets the run setting of the same name, see the [configuration reference](configuration.md). Not given means: taken from the config files, else the built-in default.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--run-id` | `RUN_ID` | from config | Name of the run. Output file: `<output_dir>`/`<run_id>`.jsonl |
| `--codebook` | `CODEBOOK` | from config | Codebook YAML path |
| `--codebook-id` | `CODEBOOK_ID` | from config | Recorded codebook id (default: codebook 'id' or file stem) |
| `--codebook-version` | `CODEBOOK_VERSION` | from config | Recorded codebook version (default: codebook 'version' or '1.0') |
| `--dataset` | `DATASET` | from config | Input items (.jsonl/.json/.csv/.tsv/.xlsx) |
| `--dataset-sheet` | `DATASET_SHEET` | from config | Sheet name for .xlsx input |
| `--dataset-name` | `DATASET_NAME` | from config | Recorded dataset name (default: dataset file stem) |
| `--dataset-revision` | `DATASET_REVISION` | from config | Recorded dataset revision/version (free text) |
| `--id-field` | `ID_FIELD` | from config | Field holding the item id in the dataset |
| `--text-field` | `TEXT_FIELD` | from config | Field holding the text to annotate |
| `--split-field` | `SPLIT_FIELD` | from config | Field used by split_value |
| `--split-value` | `SPLIT_VALUE` | from config | Keep only records with split_field == split_value |
| `--sample-size` | `SAMPLE_SIZE` | from config | Number of items (default: all) |
| `--sampling` | `{first_n_by_id,random}` | from config | How sample_size items are chosen: the first N in id order, or N at random |
| `--sampling-seed` | `SAMPLING_SEED` | from config | Random seed for sampling: random |
| `--sample-id` | `SAMPLE_ID` | from config | Recorded sample id (default: derived from the sample contents) |
| `--provider` | `{ollama,mistral_api,claude_api,openai_compatible,stub,replay}` | from config | Model provider |
| `--model-tag` | `MODEL_TAG` | from config | Model name as the provider knows it (e.g. llama3.1:8b) |
| `--model-digest` | `MODEL_DIGEST` | from config | Recorded model digest. 'auto' reads it from Ollama |
| `--api-base` | `API_BASE` | from config | Base URL of the API. Required for openai_compatible, optional for the other API providers |
| `--api-key-env` | `API_KEY_ENV` | from config | Environment variable holding the API key |
| `--ollama-host` | `OLLAMA_HOST` | from config | Ollama server address (default: the OLLAMA_HOST variable, else http://localhost:11434) |
| `--num-ctx` | `NUM_CTX` | from config | Context window in tokens. Sent to Ollama only, recorded for every run |
| `--temperature` | `TEMPERATURE` | from config | Sampling temperature |
| `--seed` | `SEED` | from config | Generation seed, sent to providers that support one |
| `--max-tokens` | `MAX_TOKENS` | from config | Maximum response length in tokens (claude_api uses 1024 when not set, ollama ignores it) |
| `--json-mode` / `--no-json-mode` |  | from config | openai_compatible only: request response_format json_object |
| `--timeout` | `TIMEOUT` | from config | Timeout per request, in seconds |
| `--max-retries` | `MAX_RETRIES` | from config | Attempts per item for API providers, with growing waits in between. Ollama makes one attempt |
| `--replay-from` | `REPLAY_FROM` | from config | provider 'replay': earlier run file with raw_response |
| `--prompt-template` | `PROMPT_TEMPLATE` | from config | Built-in template name, or the path of a template YAML file |
| `--few-shot` / `--no-few-shot` |  | from config | Show the codebook's examples in the prompt |
| `--evidence` / `--no-evidence` |  | from config | Ask for verbatim quotes that support each present category |
| `--evidence-policy` | `{report,enforce}` | from config | report: only record quote checks. enforce: set a category absent if no quote is verified |
| `--verify` / `--no-verify` |  | from config | Ask the model to check and correct its first answer in a second call |
| `--output-dir` | `OUTPUT_DIR` | from config | Folder for the run file |
| `--concurrency` | `CONCURRENCY` | from config | Number of items sent to the model at the same time |
| `--store-text` / `--no-store-text` |  | from config | Write the item text into each record |
| `--store-raw-response` / `--no-store-raw-response` |  | from config | Write the full model answer into each record |
| `--strict-digest` / `--no-strict-digest` |  | from config | Stop if the observed Ollama digest differs from model_digest |
| `--force-resume` / `--no-force-resume` |  | from config | Resume even if the existing file came from a different config |

## cba aggregate

Group a table with one row per (text, annotator) into one item per text, with labels_per_annotator and label_majority.

    cba aggregate --output OUTPUT [options] input

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `input` | annotation table (.jsonl, .json, .csv, .tsv or .xlsx) |

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` | `OUTPUT` |  | items JSONL to write (required) |
| `--sheet` | `SHEET` |  | sheet name for .xlsx input |
| `--text-field` | `TEXT_FIELD` | `text` | text column (default: text) |
| `--annotator-field` | `ANNOTATOR_FIELD` | `annotator` | annotator column (default: annotator) |
| `--labels-field` | `LABELS_FIELD` | `annotation` | labels column (default: annotation) |
| `--group-field` | `GROUP_FIELD` |  | group by this id column instead of by text |
| `--label-sep` | `LABEL_SEP` | `,` | separator between labels in one cell (default: ,) |
| `--labels` | `LABELS` |  | comma-separated accepted labels (others become UNKNOWN:`<label>`) |
| `--map` | `RAW=LABEL` |  | map a raw label to an accepted one Repeatable. |
| `--drop` | `DROP` |  | label to drop, e.g. a 'none' label (repeatable) |
| `--threshold` | `THRESHOLD` | `0.5` | majority share (default 0.5 = at least half) |
| `--id-prefix` | `ID_PREFIX` | `item_` | prefix of the generated item ids (default: item_) |
| `--keep` | `KEEP` |  | item-level field to keep, taken from the first row (repeatable) |

## cba overlap

Mark each item whose text contains any word listed in a codebook field (case-insensitive, whole words).

    cba overlap --output OUTPUT --codebook CODEBOOK [options] input

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `input` | items file |

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-o`, `--output` | `OUTPUT` |  | items JSONL to write (required) |
| `--codebook` | `CODEBOOK` |  | codebook YAML with the word lists (required) |
| `--field` | `FIELD` | `example_words` | codebook field holding the words (default: example_words) |
| `--text-field` | `TEXT_FIELD` | `text` | text field of the items (default: text) |
| `--out-field` | `OUT_FIELD` | `lexical_overlap` | name of the flag field (default: lexical_overlap) |

## cba strip-text

Copy run files without the item text, the raw model answers and the evidence quotes (their verified flags are kept).

    cba strip-text --out-dir OUT_DIR runs ...

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `runs ...` | run JSONL file(s) |

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--out-dir` | `OUT_DIR` |  | folder for the stripped copies (required) |

## cba evaluate

Compare runs with gold labels and write an Excel workbook.

    cba evaluate --gold DATASET --runs RUNS ... [options]

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dataset`, `--gold` | `DATASET` |  | Gold dataset JSONL (required) |
| `--runs` | `RUNS ...` |  | Run JSONL files (required) |
| `--output-xlsx`, `-o` | `OUTPUT_XLSX` | `results.xlsx` | Output workbook (default: results.xlsx) |
| `--categories` | `CATEGORIES ...` |  | Category list and order. Default: sorted union of the runs' prediction keys. |
| `--codebook` | `CODEBOOK` |  | Take the category list and order from this codebook YAML (file order) |
| `--slice-by` | `FIELD` |  | Gold field to slice by, one '`<Field>` Slices' sheet each (repeatable) |
| `--agreement-slice-by` | `FIELD` |  | Gold fields for Codebook Agreement slices (repeatable, default: the --slice-by fields) |
| `--bool-labels` | `FIELD=TRUE,FALSE` |  | Render a field by truthiness with these labels (a missing value counts as false) Repeatable. |
| `--sheet1-slice-field` | `FIELD` |  | Also report Sheet1 rows per value of this field (default: pooled only) |
| `--min-cell-floor` | `MIN_CELL_FLOOR` | `5` | Minimum item count for reporting metrics in a cell (default: 5) |
| `--codebooks` | `CODEBOOKS ...` | `[]` | Codebook YAMLs for the Token Counts sheet |
| `--codebooks-dir` | `CODEBOOKS_DIR` | `codebooks` | Fallback for Token Counts: look for `<dir>`/`<codebook_id>`.yaml (default: ./codebooks) |
| `--gold-scores-field` | `GOLD_SCORES_FIELD` |  | Gold field with {category: score\|null}, for runs with ordinal scores (Ordinal sheet) |
| `--merge` |  | off | Merge into an existing workbook, replacing rows of re-evaluated runs |

**Gold data fields**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--id-field` | `ID_FIELD` | `item_id` | Item id field in the gold data (default: item_id) |
| `--majority-field` | `MAJORITY_FIELD` | `label_majority` | Field with the majority/consensus label list (default: label_majority) |
| `--annotators-field` | `ANNOTATORS_FIELD` | `labels_per_annotator` | Field with {annotator: [labels]} (default: labels_per_annotator). If absent, annotator-based metrics are skipped. |

## cba bootstrap

Paired bootstrap confidence intervals and p-values against the first run.

    cba bootstrap --gold DATASET --runs RUNS ... [options]

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dataset`, `--gold` | `DATASET` |  | Gold dataset/sample JSONL (required) |
| `--runs` | `RUNS ...` |  | Run JSONL files. The FIRST is the baseline (required) |
| `--resamples` | `RESAMPLES` | `5000` | Bootstrap resamples (default: 5000) |
| `--seed` | `SEED` | `42` | RNG seed (default: 42) |
| `--categories` | `CATEGORIES ...` |  | Category list and order. Default: sorted union of the runs' prediction keys. |
| `--codebook` | `CODEBOOK` |  | Take the category list and order from this codebook YAML (file order) |
| `--save-npz` | `SAVE_NPZ` |  | Save replicates and point estimates to this .npz |
| `--output-csv` | `OUTPUT_CSV` |  | Save a tidy results table to this CSV |

**Gold data fields**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--id-field` | `ID_FIELD` | `item_id` | Item id field in the gold data (default: item_id) |
| `--majority-field` | `MAJORITY_FIELD` | `label_majority` | Field with the majority/consensus label list (default: label_majority) |
| `--annotators-field` | `ANNOTATORS_FIELD` | `labels_per_annotator` | Field with {annotator: [labels]} (default: labels_per_annotator). If absent, annotator-based metrics are skipped. |

## cba disagreements

Export the items where runs disagree with each other or with the annotators.

    cba disagreements --gold DATASET --runs RUNS ... -o OUTPUT_CSV [options]

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dataset`, `--gold` | `DATASET` |  | Gold dataset JSONL (required) |
| `--runs` | `RUNS ...` |  | Run JSONL files (required) |
| `--output-csv`, `-o` | `OUTPUT_CSV` |  | Output CSV (required) |
| `--key` | `{codebook_id,run_id}` | `codebook_id` | Column key per run (default: codebook_id, runs sharing one collapse to the last) |
| `--categories` | `CATEGORIES ...` |  | Category list and order. Default: sorted union of the runs' prediction keys. |
| `--codebook` | `CODEBOOK` |  | Take the category list and order from this codebook YAML (file order) |
| `--item-field` | `FIELD` |  | Extra gold field to copy into the CSV after 'text' (repeatable) |
| `--text-field` | `TEXT_FIELD` | `text` | Gold text field (default: text) |
| `--empty-label` | `EMPTY_LABEL` | `(none)` | Display string for an empty label set (default: '(none)') |

**Gold data fields**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--id-field` | `ID_FIELD` | `item_id` | Item id field in the gold data (default: item_id) |
| `--majority-field` | `MAJORITY_FIELD` | `label_majority` | Field with the majority/consensus label list (default: label_majority) |
| `--annotators-field` | `ANNOTATORS_FIELD` | `labels_per_annotator` | Field with {annotator: [labels]} (default: labels_per_annotator). If absent, annotator-based metrics are skipped. |

## cba annotator-disagreements

Export, per item and category, whether the human annotators disagreed.

    cba annotator-disagreements --gold DATASET -o OUTPUT_CSV [options]

**Options**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dataset`, `--gold` | `DATASET` |  | Gold dataset JSONL (required) |
| `--output-csv`, `-o` | `OUTPUT_CSV` |  | Output CSV (required) |
| `--split` | `SPLIT` | `test` | Keep records whose split field equals this. 'all' keeps every record (default: test, falls back to all records if nothing matches) |
| `--split-field` | `SPLIT_FIELD` | `split` | Split field name (default: split) |
| `--categories` | `CATEGORIES ...` |  | Category list and order. Default: sorted union of annotator labels. |
| `--codebook` | `CODEBOOK` |  | Take the category list and order from this codebook YAML (file order) |

**Gold data fields**

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--id-field` | `ID_FIELD` | `item_id` | Item id field in the gold data (default: item_id) |
| `--majority-field` | `MAJORITY_FIELD` | `label_majority` | Field with the majority/consensus label list (default: label_majority) |
| `--annotators-field` | `ANNOTATORS_FIELD` | `labels_per_annotator` | Field with {annotator: [labels]} (default: labels_per_annotator). If absent, annotator-based metrics are skipped. |
